Size of habitat areas is calculated as Microsoft’s contribution amount divided by the cost per acre of the habitat
protection project as determined by the partner organization. These amounts are net of overhead costs.
Funded is defined as where agreements have been signed and contributions have been made.
Protected is defined as areas that are legally designated as permanently protected by government regulation.
